blocks.content: In the previous lesson, we learned to create our own functions. More specifically, we wrote the function definition ourselves. These are called user-defined functions.
However, C provides some built-in functions that are readily available to the programmer to use; such functions are known as standard library functions.
Next, we'll look at some commonly used standard library functions.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
